DESCRIPTION: A processor that takes messages and can be asked what it holds. Hand-written, as most are. Its two inputs are what the show's Mount/Slot rows point at, so a Feed has somewhere real to land and `wfg validate` has an address to check.

meter.DESCRIPTION: What the desk reports. Read-only, which is what a meter is.

mute.DESCRIPTION: Mute the input. What a footer releases.

input.DESCRIPTION: The processor's inputs, which the show declares as slots.

1.DESCRIPTION: Input 1: level of whatever is fed to it.

2.DESCRIPTION: Input 2: level of whatever is fed to it.
